entries.2cbf8c2f34d58599: The breakdown of consolidated net sales of ¥104,280 million for the fiscal year ended May 2026, by net sales to external customers by segment, is overseas wholesale business ¥82,862 million (about 79%), domestic wholesale business ¥13,193 million, retail business ¥4,062 million, and other ¥4,161 million. Net sales by region are Europe and the Middle East ¥26,007 million, Japan ¥21,417 million, the United States ¥17,146 million, Asia ¥15,995 million, South America ¥10,442 million, and North and Central America (excluding the United States) ¥8,769 million, and the overseas total has expanded to about 4 times that of Japan. By product and service, seeds and seedlings account for the majority at ¥91,013 million, and materials are ¥4,945 million. The number of consolidated employees is 3,108.
entries.2e9073b79150f179: SAKATA SEED CORPORATION is a seed and seedling company headquartered in Tsuzuki Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture. It was founded in 1913 as Sakata Farm, and forms a group consisting of the company, 37 subsidiaries and 4 affiliated companies. The number of employees on a consolidated basis is 3,108 (as of May 31, 2026).
